defects.description: An absolute deadline retains a stale wall-to-monotonic offset after a clock adjustment.

trigger.input: Schedule wall 1010 at wall 1000/mono 0; rewind wall to 990 then advance both by 10; poll.

defects.why_missed: The clock advances with a constant offset in existing tests.

defects.description: Relative timers measure elapsed duration with wall time, delaying delivery after a backward adjustment.

trigger.input: Schedule after 10 at wall 1000/mono 0; advance mono to 10 and wall to 990; poll.

defects.why_missed: Existing relative timers use a wall clock that never changes offset.
